summary: The global marcom team is driving a China-first marketing strategy, with Asia Start and Intelligent China as top priorities, while managing a mix of urgent operational fixes, website redesign feedback, and upcoming event preparations.
summaryDetail: The most immediate issue is an Outlook account lockout affecting the team, requiring password resets and device re-logins, plus backend confirmation from JSB. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is at a critical feedback stage: Joseph must share his HTML design, and he, Julie, and the speaker will meet to consolidate specific feedback before Joker implements changes. The broader strategic push remains on China-based programs—Asia Start and Intelligent China—with US partnerships on hold; Joseph is drafting target audience and prompt research, and conversion tracking needs a brief. Looking ahead, the team is preparing for the Asia Start campus visit on November 2 (photographer to be booked) and the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum, while also handling EQUIS re-accreditation press release feedback and exploring opportunities like the Sino-Swiss Economic Forum and IEDP Index.
